policy.writeModel: parallel read-only subagents, serialized main-integrator writes
policy.adjustmentRule: At 15-minute cadence, loops must ship one coherent visible improvement or report a real blocker. No placeholder progress posts.

runs.label: facility scale and hangar depth pass
runs.notes: Expanded scene footprint/room separation and added distant hangar service depth.

runs.label: fixed facility navigation and asteroid rim pass
runs.notes: Pivoted from orbit showcase to fixed front-facing WASD/click facility traversal with wider room separation and asteroid rim framing.

runs.label: embedded remote bay visual scale pass
runs.notes: Converted room pads into larger embedded asteroid-wall bay frames and pushed districts farther apart across a larger facility footprint.

runs.label: foreground asteroid cutaway frame pass
runs.notes: Added heavy foreground/side/upper asteroid cutaway framing so the fixed camera reads like looking into a carved facility.

runs.label: cutaway rock strata material pass
runs.notes: Added layered shadow shelves, mineral veins, and side fracture seams to make the asteroid cutaway read as carved rock instead of a flat frame.

runs.label: operator avatar kit proxy asset pass
runs.notes: Added hand-blocked operator suit kit details: shoulder yokes, chest plates, role stripes, backpack blocks, gauntlets, and boot stance bars so agents read as suited operators at facility distance.
